thread:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up 12: proposing an 'orbit lanes' migration to thin the inference-config contract. Goal: move policy evaluation off hotpath, shrink runtime interface, and create a short-lived debt-sink for legacy adapters.
aj: Orbit lanes? explain the staging.
maria: Think of lanes as tenant cohorts. Steps: 1) deploy read-only policy-plane, 2) parquet snapshot backfill from replica, 3) delta stream via CDC for near-realtime, 4) sidecar shim per legacy adapter, 5) route lane 0 (5% tenants) to policy-plane, ramp lanes, retire shims.
simon: Parquet snapshot is new to this thread. Why parquet?
maria: Parquet snapshot on read-replica lets us export a consistent bulk snapshot without holding locks. Consumer will bulk-load into policy_plane store. Then CDC brings us up-to-date.
katie: Sidecar details? how does that avoid changing all adapters instantly?
maria: Sidecar exposes the old local API but proxies lookups to policy-plane and performs field mapping (`policy_v1` -> `policy_v2`). It also implements a safety leash: if policy-plane misses or errors > threshold, it fails open to legacy store for that call.
aj: Who is authoritative for writes during cutover?
maria: New policy service is authoritative. We'll block direct legacy writes at Tcut and require writes through policy service which writes new store and emits CDC events for any downstream sync. No split-brain allowed.
simon: Routing changes? need fine-grained shard mapping.
maria: Router will assign tenants into lanes using hash shard config. Envoy filter `lane-router` inspects `x-tenant-shard` header and routes to policy-plane for enabled lanes. Start lane 0 = 5% tenants, ramp lane by lane.
infra-bot: deploy note: create envoy filter `lane-router` and canary router image: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/router router=router:lane-canary`. Use staged rollout and `kubectl rollout status` checks.
katie: Monitoring and SLO gates?
maria: Track metrics: `policy_plane_lookup_rate`, `policy_plane_5xx_rate`, `policy_plane_cache_miss_rate`, `policy_sync_lag_ms`, `adapter.sidecar_fallback_rate`. Gates: abort if 5xx_rate > 0.25% sustained 5m or p95 latency +40ms sustained 10m.
aj: Tests before canary?
maria: Contract lint, integration with sidecar, synthetic probe per lane every 30s, load test at expected lookup QPS, and a chaos run that kills sidecar to validate fallback.
simon: Rollback plan?
maria: Revert envoy filter and router image, flip tenant lane mapping back to legacy, disable sidecars by policy. Also a circuit-breaker in router to fallback to legacy if policy-plane error rate spikes.
katie: Debt management? we need a ticket to avoid permanent sidecars.
maria: Created INF-9009: "orbit-lanes debt-sink: audit & prune legacy adapters". Plan: 6-week window post-cutover to remove shims.
aj: Ops cost impact?
maria: Short term: extra infra for sidecars + CDC consumer, estimate +3% CPU/GPU infra delta for the policy lookup layer. Add to next ops forecast.
simon: Any schema lock concerns?
maria: Parquet snapshot avoids locking. Any migrations to policy-plane schema will be additive; schedule short maintenance window if exclusive locks needed (<2m).
infra-bot: Note: schedule snapshot during low traffic window and ensure backup retention.
katie: Owners and timeline?
maria: Owners: maria (architecture), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (ops). Timeline: spike/tests this sprint, canary next week, gradual ramp 3wk, full cut + shim prune by month-end.
aj: I'll own runtime integration and load tests.
simon: I'll own envoy filter and shard mapping.
katie: I'll prepare dashboards and runbook.
maria: I'll update RFC with parquet export script, CDC consumer config, sidecar image, and the lane-by-lane rollout checklist. Sync tomorrow 9:30 for dry-run. :rocket:
